# Municipal Ordinance No. KauBayanBlg02, Series of 1999

**An Ordinance Imposing Taxes on Owners of Videoke Machines for Commercial Use, Establishing Rules and Regulations (Kautusang Bayan Blg. 01, Serye ng Taong 1999)**

## Summary

This ordinance imposes taxes on owners of videoke machines used for commercial purposes in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], Quezon. It requires a Mayor's Permit and a business license for commercial videoke operations. The ordinance establishes operating hours, age restrictions for minors, volume regulations, and prescribes penalties for violations. It was enacted pursuant to the Local Government Code of [[1991]], [[Sec-142-RA7160|Section 142]] (Article II) and [[Sec-147-RA7160|Section 147]], which authorize municipalities to levy taxes on businesses and regulate activities.

## Key Provisions

**Section 1 — License Requirement.** Any person or entity operating a videoke machine for commercial purposes must secure the following:
- A. Mayor's Permit
- B. Tax payment (as provided below)

**Section 2 — Fees and Taxes.** Any owner or operator of a videoke machine for commercial use must obtain a Mayor's Permit and pay the required tax of Three Hundred Pesos (P 300.00) and a business permit fee of Six Hundred Pesos (P 600.00) per quarter, with the fee payable quarterly.

**Section 3 — Operating Rules and Regulations.**
1. Minors (below 18 years old) are prohibited from using videoke machines from 9:00 PM until 8:00 AM the following morning, and during school hours
2. No person under eighteen (18) years of age shall be allowed to use videoke machines without parental consent
3. Sound/volume must be kept at a moderate level

**Section 4 — Repealing Clause.** Any existing ordinance or provision that conflicts with this ordinance is hereby repealed.

**Section 5 — Penalty.** Any person found violating this ordinance shall be fined Five Thousand Pesos (P 5,000.00) or imprisonment of one (1) month (not to exceed six (6) months). Repeat offenders may face higher penalties.

**Section 6 — Effectivity.** This ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its publication.
